title: fix: let post-core plugin updates finish without an implicit deadline
body:
Related: #153043

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes healthy post-core plugin updates being stopped by an internal step allowance when the operator did not supply `--timeout`.

## User Impact

Plugin package work can finish without an implicit work deadline. Explicit deadlines still stop and settle the writer, and metadata probes remain bounded. Direct plugin updates and standalone install defaults retain their existing behavior.

## Why This Change Was Made

The post-core callers know whether the operator requested a deadline, but passed only their numeric internal allowance to installers. This carries that choice separately through convergence, configured-plugin repairs, transport adapters, and fallback attempts. Consent, lease ownership, cancellation, and rollback stay with their existing owners.

## Evidence

On official main, a healthy 65-second package child was killed by a 60-second internal allowance. The same child completed with a larger explicit allowance, ruling out an invalid package fixture. The regression exercises the real post-core API, installers, process runner, transactions, and installed package files, with a synthetic npm executable.

The earlier owner/sibling run passed 222 tests across nine files, and the adapter/regression run passed 155 tests across five files. Historical independent behavior validation covers healthy work beyond 60 seconds, explicit cancellation, direct omission, fallback, and a stalled finite probe. After correcting the finalization adapter, 115 CLI owner/finalization tests and 14 budget/transport tests pass. Full-module P0-P2 review accepted the correction; its sole index-only finding was resolved by staging the reviewed bytes.

Physical qualification passed as recorded below. Historical `483f` hosted CI failed on the old canonical shard partition and an `ENOTEMPTY` memory-compaction fixture teardown. Both raw failures are retained; the latter was not proved to be caused by this PR. Current head `1f5548761b7e287dc3b2505e60fb6c3b28811c88` is the supported GitHub merge of qualified `483f` and canonical `6f36619571aebcf883e44ed488b5c15b4cce1f6b`. Both parents and the hosted tree were verified. All 17 authored file blobs, modes, and the complete authored diff are byte-identical. Canonical movement was assessed. Supplemental borrowed-overlay checks passed 7 memory fixture cases, 11 writer queue cases, and 8 plugin budget/finalization cases. These 26 cases are not physical exact-lock qualification; two donor version differences are recorded. [Exact-current-head hosted CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35465931222) and the aggregate gate passed. Both previously failing jobs pass on this head. The physical proof below retains its `a79d` and `483f` source labels. Native preparation and merge passed; landed as `e9390ffd104ef34f4f43be3118c56c1ee40f5f54`. Local broad lint preparation rejected the borrowed TypeScript dependency before lint ran; matching core-config scoped lint passed. This local API proof uses a synthetic npm child and does not claim external registry or full-upgrade coverage.

<!-- post-core-budget-public-proof -->

Historical head `14e281c060bfa9e2bdefdc6279567d0bfa2721af` had an out-of-scope `timeoutMs` reference in finalization and two strict test-indexing errors. The corrected producer derives the work deadline from the operator input using the existing parser. The existing CLI lease case and new finalization regression both reproduced the original error before passing with the correction. Qualified head `483f0595cac8b54febfdb6f4dd0e47d422068ca5` is a direct successor of `a79d87062c32d62fb48da6a1bed83262a5a62352`. Its [only change](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/compare/a79d87062c32d62fb48da6a1bed83262a5a62352...483f0595cac8b54febfdb6f4dd0e47d422068ca5) is a documented lint exception for capturing the original lifecycle method before invoking it with `.call(this, phase)`. Every production blob and every executable test byte is unchanged. Matching local lint and all eight cases pass on the successor; independent review of this correction is clean. Physical successor test qualification passed. Hosted checks passed on current merge head `1f554`; native preparation and merge passed, landing as `e9390ffd104ef34f4f43be3118c56c1ee40f5f54`. The published `a79d` recording and all 11 source-blind checks retain their exact source label and apply through this byte-identical executable bridge. The recordings below remain historical resume-only evidence and do not qualify the full corrected PR.


Replacement finalization and resume recording, `a79d87062c32d62fb48da6a1bed83262a5a62352`. This supersedes the historical `14e281` resume-only green. It shows actual child completion and disk `2.0.0` with an omitted deadline, and cancellation with disk `1.0.0` retained under an explicit deadline. No child survives settlement. The external npm and Doctor/config executables are synthetic. This recording is API proof. The separate installed-updater compatibility result appears below.
